name: Goliath
description: Firefox-based browser automation for AI agents with configurable anti-detection measures

GOLIATH_API_KEY.description: Secret key for the cookie-import endpoint. Cookie import is disabled when unset. Only set this if you need to import browser cookies and the server is local or access-controlled.

GOLIATH_ACCESS_KEY.description: Global bearer token for all routes except /health. Required for any non-loopback client.

GOLIATH_BIND_HOST.description: Network interface to bind. Defaults to 127.0.0.1; use 0.0.0.0 only with GOLIATH_ACCESS_KEY.

GOLIATH_UPLOADS_DIR.description: Directory containing files agents may attach to browser upload controls. Paths outside this root are rejected.

GOLIATH_CRASH_REPORT_ENABLED.description: Opt in to anonymized crash/hang telemetry. An explicit HTTPS GOLIATH_CRASH_REPORT_URL is also required.

GOLIATH_CRASH_REPORT_URL.description: Trusted HTTPS endpoint for opt-in crash/hang telemetry. No endpoint is built in.

GOLIATH_EXECUTABLE.description: External Goliath/Camoufox executable to use instead of downloading the bundled browser. Compatibility aliases: GOLIATH_EXECUTABLE_PATH, CAMOUFOX_EXECUTABLE, CAMOUFOX_EXECUTABLE_PATH, CAMOFOX_EXECUTABLE_PATH.

GOLIATH_CHECKPOINTS_DIR.description: Directory for storage-state checkpoints used by isolated session forks. Defaults to ~/.goliath/checkpoints.

port.description: Server port (used if url not set)

autoStart.description: Auto-start the goliath-browser server with the Gateway

sessionTimeoutMs.description: Session inactivity timeout in milliseconds (server default: 1800000)

browserIdleTimeoutMs.description: Kill browser after this many ms with no sessions (0 = never)

maxOldSpaceSize.description: Node.js V8 heap limit in MB

apiKey.description: Secret key for cookie import endpoint. Cookie import is disabled if unset. Set via GOLIATH_API_KEY env var.

accessKey.description: If set, all routes (except /health) require Authorization: Bearer <key>. Set via GOLIATH_ACCESS_KEY env var.

crashReportEnabled.description: Opt in to anonymized crash/hang telemetry. An explicit HTTPS endpoint is also required.

crashReportUrl.description: Trusted HTTPS telemetry endpoint. No endpoint is built in. Set via GOLIATH_CRASH_REPORT_URL.

crashReporter.description: Optional anonymized crash/hang telemetry sent only to an operator-configured HTTPS relay.
crashReporter.optIn: Set GOLIATH_CRASH_REPORT_ENABLED=true and GOLIATH_CRASH_REPORT_URL to a trusted HTTPS endpoint.
dataCollected: error type and anonymized stack trace

securityModel.architecture: All process.env reads are in lib/config.js. All child_process usage is in lib/launcher.js and plugins/youtube/youtube.js. server.js has route handlers but zero process.env reads and zero child_process imports. No single file combines secrets access with network sends.
securityModel.cookieImport: DISABLED by default. Requires GOLIATH_API_KEY to be explicitly set. Without the key, the server rejects all cookie requests with 403. Cookie files are read from a sandboxed directory (~/.goliath/cookies/) with path traversal protection.
securityModel.accessControl: GOLIATH_ACCESS_KEY provides global bearer auth for all routes (except /health). Recommended for any non-localhost deployment.
securityModel.crashReporting: Disabled by default with no built-in endpoint. Requires explicit opt-in plus an operator-configured HTTPS relay. No page content, URLs, domains, cookies, tokens, IPs, or user data is sent.
securityModel.binaryDownload: Install the Camoufox runtime powering Goliath with npx camoufox-js fetch unless GOLIATH_EXECUTABLE points to an external bundle. Downloads are verified by camoufox-js.
securityModel.sessionPersistence: User sessions are persisted to ~/.goliath/profiles/ so authenticated browsing survives restarts. Explicit checkpoints are stored separately under ~/.goliath/checkpoints/ and contain browser storage state, not live DOM or JavaScript heap. UserIds are hashed for directory names. Disable persistence via plugin config.
securityModel.semanticSafety: Page content is labeled untrusted. Semantic action contracts are bound to one snapshot, fail closed on stale or uncertain identities, support origin policy, require confirmation for sensitive effects, and block high-severity prompt-injection signals by default.
securityModel.noEmbeddedSecrets: Zero credentials, private keys, tokens, or telemetry endpoints ship in this package. Runtime secrets are supplied through environment variables.
